historical.interpretation: Overlap establishes contact, not a correct pore boundary. Any-overlap F1 is a conditional attainable value with the existing prediction count, not a universal ceiling after merging or recovering missed pores.

noise_structure.scope: 32 clean validation backgrounds, all counts. Shared sqrt normalization and input sigma1. Repeat difference divided by sqrt2; acquisition noise may be correlated. RMS and row-MAD are distinct diagnostics, not interchangeable variance estimates.
